name: Example To Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to be a visible light to others by living in obedience to God's commands, which serve as a guiding lamp for life. Jesus instructs His followers to let their good works shine openly so that others may glorify God, emphasizing the importance of genuine actions over mere words. Believers are urged to imitate God as His beloved children and to welcome those weak in faith with grace rather than judgment, demonstrating a Christ-centered example that leads others toward eternal life.
